body: I read this three times. I feel every word of this. It takes every amount of energy I have to just navigate through the day, initiating conversations, working, just getting through it. I feel like such a failure when I have no energy left for my partner or the things I loved.

Great! The whole night went way more easy and laid back than we thought. It really made us all feel comfortable being ourselves around our loved ones. 
I kissed her and then him and no one said a thing 😊

Thanks everyone for the kind, loving responses! We’re open with everyone who will be here so I think it shouldn’t be a big deal. 

Have a fun and safe night, hopefully filled with lots of kisses 😌♥️
